frost-deep.purpose: Hover fills, tags, waiting Roll pill, timer track.

glass-surface.purpose: Panels, sheets, seat chips, die well, seed line.

tile-white.purpose: Board tiles, inputs, segments, die picker cards.

ink-navy.purpose: Primary text, primary buttons, room pill, toast; marble eyes and pips in both themes.

ruby.purpose: Player colour 0; six pips on the glass die; errors.

amber.purpose: Player colour 2; takes ink text on the Roll pill.

cobalt.purpose: Player colour 3; brand bead, focus ring, caret, focused borders.

live-violet.purpose: Reserved: legal landing squares and movable guti only.

label.purpose: Field labels, legends, Room code and Rolls headings; never a decorative eyebrow.

shadows.name: frost-lift
shadows.purpose: Panels, code card, board plate, die well, sheets.

shadows.name: marble-body
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 65%, black), inset 0 -0.14em 0.22em rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22), 0 0.12em 0.22em rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3)
shadows.purpose: Every guti and bead; em-based so it scales.

shadows.name: marble-movable
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 65%, black), inset 0 -0.14em 0.22em rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22), 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5.5px var(--live), 0 0.12em 0.22em rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3)
shadows.purpose: Movable guti: white ring wrapped in live violet.

shadows.name: die-glass
shadows.purpose: Glass die skin; other skins keep the 5px/12px contact shadow with their own inner tint.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for presses, hops, sheets, toast, capture flight.

motion.name: hop-step
motion.purpose: Guti move: 0.34u arc with stretch 1.1x0.94 and squash 1.06x0.92; transform only.

motion.name: arrow-flight
motion.purpose: U-arrow flight into the home lane.

motion.name: capture-flight
motion.purpose: Captured guti flies home wearing the x_x face, held 1.6s after landing.

motion.name: seal-and-mix
motion.value: beads 520ms, 50ms stagger, ease-in cubic-bezier(.5,0,.75,0); die lands after 560ms + 50ms per bead
motion.purpose: Sealing beads fall into the die well while the die tumbles (0.5s per turn).

motion.name: die-land
motion.purpose: Die face settles; Mochi skin squishes over 500ms instead.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: CSS animations and transitions 0.01ms x1; script skips hops, captures, bead falls, glides
motion.purpose: Only the linear turn timer keeps draining.

motion.name: sound
motion.value: Web Audio synthesis, master gain 0.32 + compressor
motion.purpose: Rattle, land (six chime), rising hop tick, arrow whoosh, capture/captured, home, win, lose, join.

motion.name: vibration
motion.purpose: Mute silences sound and vibration together; remembered.

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Roll Pill
components.description: The 76px Roll pill in the roller's colour, with sheen, glaze and a nudge; waiting state switches to frost.
components.css: .ds-roll-row { display: grid; gap: 10px; width: 300px; } .ds-roll { font-family: Gabarito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; height: 76px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.28), rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 55%), #d0263f; color: #fff; font-weight: 900; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35), inset 0 -6px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18), 0 8px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22); transition: transform 0.14s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.14s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-roll:active:not([disabled]) { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-roll:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f45d6; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-roll-amber { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.28), rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 55%), #e39a00; color: #0f1b33; } .ds-roll-wait { background: #d3e2dc; color: #33435f; box-shadow: none; font-size: 18px; cursor: default; }

components.name: Guti Marble
components.description: The kancha marble used at every scale; face hidden below 20px; movable state rings in live violet; captured state shows x_x.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; } .ds-guti { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 31% 27%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.95) 0 10%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 11%), radial-gradient(circle at 70% 78%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.45) 0 5%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 6%), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 56%, var(--c) 0 47%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 52%, white) 48% 72%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 20%, white) 73%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 65%, black), inset 0 -0.14em 0.22em rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22), 0 0.12em 0.22em rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-bead { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-can { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 65%, black), inset 0 -0.14em 0.22em rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22), 0 0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 0 5.5px #7b2ff7, 0 0.12em 0.22em rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); animation: ds-hop 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-hop { 0%, 100% { translate: 0 0; } 40% { translate: 0 -6px; } } .ds-eyes { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 46%; height: 24%; transform: translate(-50%, -30%); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-eyes i { width: 32%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 62%, #0f1b33 0 42%, #fff 44%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); transform-origin: 50% 60%; animation: ds-blink 5.2s infinite; } .ds-eyes::before, .ds-eyes::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 118%; width: 22%; height: 34%; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(255 140 160 / 0.55); } .ds-eyes::before { left: -14%; } .ds-eyes::after { right: -14%; } @keyframes ds-blink { 0%, 93%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); } 95.5% { transform: scaleY(0.1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-can, .ds-eyes i { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Kancha Glass"**

Fairsix is a game of glass marbles on a frosted table. Every guti is a kancha marble with an opaque coloured core, a clear rim, a big soft highlight and a small face that blinks; the board is a sheet of frosted glass laid with rounded white tiles; every roll is the players' sealed beads dropping into one die. The same bead form appears at every scale, from the 12px proof bead to the 92px winner's marble, and that repetition is the identity.

The tone is "cute but grown-up": warm, soft and charming, never cartoon candy. Charm lives in the objects (faces, blush, kitty ears on a die skin), while the chrome around them stays quiet: one ink, one frosted ground, pills and rounded panels, no decoration. Contrast is deliberately strong; the four marble colours run at full saturation against a pale mint ground in light mode and a bottle-glass ground in dark mode. The world refuses the glossy gold-framed 3D board on a purple gradient that commercial Ludo apps ship.

Density follows the phone: the board takes the full width, seats compress to one row of four chips above it, and the tray (die well plus a big Roll pill) sits under the thumb. Wider screens move seats, tray and roll log into a 340px column beside the board.
keyCharacteristics: One bead form at every scale: marble guti, seat marbles, brand bead, proof beads, seal-and-mix beads.
Every corner rounded; pills for actions, 18-28px radii for containers, rounded tiles on the board.
Four full-saturation player colours plus one reserved violet that means "legal move" and nothing else.
Gabarito at heavy weights (800-900) for anything you act on; tabular numerals everywhere.
Motion is physical and short: hops, squash, tumble, land; all transform-only.

rules.name: The One Live Colour Rule
rules.body: Violet means "you can go here / you can move this". It never decorates, never brands, never signals anything else.

rules.name: The Marble Owns Its Colour Rule
rules.body: A player colour appears only where that player is: their marble, base, lane, arrow, seat, timer and Roll pill. Chrome stays ink and frost.

rules.name: The Two Glasses Rule
rules.body: Light is mint-frosted glass; dark is bottle glass. Both themes swap every neutral and brighten the four player colours and violet; nothing else changes.

rules.name: The Heavy Means Touchable Rule
rules.body: Weight 800-900 marks what you act on or must read at a glance; reading text stays at 500-600.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers always align: codes, roll indices, face counts and timers use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Objects Have Depth, Chrome Floats Rule
rules.body: Marbles, dice and the Roll pill are shaded like physical things; containers only float on the one frost-lift shadow. No other shadow recipes.

rules.name: The No Sharp Corner Rule
rules.body: If it has a corner, it has a radius; if it has a stroke end, it is round. Where a rectangle must be clipped (the seat timer bar), the parent's radius clips it.

dos: Do build every guti, bead and seat marker from the one marble recipe, scaled; drop the face below 20px.
Do round every corner: pills (999px) for actions, 12/18/28px for containers, 0.26u for board tiles, round caps on every stroke.
Do keep live violet for legal landing squares and movable guti only.
Do fill the Roll pill with the roller's own colour, with ink-navy text on amber and white on the other three.
Do size board pieces in board cells (u) so the board scales as one object.
Do keep motion on transform and opacity, at 150ms per hop, and honour reduced motion in both CSS and script.
Do keep sound subtle and synthesised, and let one mute control silence vibration too.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and give every player a name as well as a colour.
donts: Don't use a sharp corner or a square stroke end anywhere, including board squares.
Don't use violet, or any fifth hue, for branding, decoration or status.
Don't fade the waiting Roll pill with opacity; switch it to frost-deep with ink-slate text so its label stays legible.
Don't add gold frames, purple gradients or glossy 3D bevels to the board.
Don't let a die skin touch a roll or imply luck; skins are looks only.
Don't use the label style as a decorative eyebrow above headlines; it labels a field, a code or a list.
Don't add shadow recipes beyond frost lift for containers and the object shading for marbles, dice and the Roll pill.
